SCRIPT.ENGLISH: I’m curious about your ex-boyfriend history, Manager.
SCRIPT.CHINESE_SIMPLIFIED: 我有点好奇...科长您的感情史
SCRIPT.CHINESE_TRADITIONAL: 我很好奇課長你的戀愛史
SCRIPT.JAPANESE: 課長の元カレの歴史が気になります
SCRIPT.INDONESIAN: Aku penasaran sama mantan-mantan pacar Manajer, deh.
SCRIPT.PERSIAN: من در مورد سابقه دوست پسر سابق شما کنجکاو هستم، مدیر.

SCRIPT.KOREAN: 엄청 많이 사귀어봤을 거 아니에요. 예전에 회사까지 찾아온 남자도 있고.
SCRIPT.ENGLISH: You must’ve dated a lot, right? There were even guys who came to the office before.
SCRIPT.CHINESE_SIMPLIFIED: 您以前不是交过挺多的吗？以前还有找到公司来的男人呢
SCRIPT.CHINESE_TRADITIONAL: 你一定交過非常多男朋友吧。以前不是還有男的找到公司來嗎
SCRIPT.JAPANESE: たくさん付き合ったんですよね？前に会社まで来た男の人もいたし
SCRIPT.INDONESIAN: Pasti udah banyak ya? Dulu aja pernah ada cowok yang sampe dateng ke kantor.
SCRIPT.PORTUGUESE: Aposto que teve vários. Inclusive um deles veio até o escritório atrás de você.
SCRIPT.SPANISH: Seguro tuvo muchos. Incluso uno de ellos vino hasta la oficina a buscarla.
SCRIPT.PERSIAN: حتما خیلی قرار گذاشتی، درسته؟ حتی بچه هایی بودند که قبلا به دفتر می آمدند.

SCRIPT.KOREAN: 아니 우유만 씨 누가 그런 거 물어보래!
SCRIPT.ENGLISH: No, Yuman! Who told you to ask that?!
SCRIPT.CHINESE_SIMPLIFIED: 不是，吴宥万，谁让你问这种问题的啦！
SCRIPT.CHINESE_TRADITIONAL: 喂，吳宥萬！誰叫你問那種東西！
SCRIPT.JAPANESE: ちょ、ウ・ユマンさん！誰がそんなこと聞いてって言ったの!
SCRIPT.INDONESIAN: Nggak, Yuman! Siapa yang nyuruh kamu nanya kayak gitu?!
SCRIPT.PORTUGUESE: Ei, Yuman! Quem te deu permissão pra fazer esse tipo de pergunta?
SCRIPT.SPANISH: ¡Oye, Yumán! ¿Quién te dijo que podías preguntar esas cosas?
SCRIPT.PERSIAN: نه، یومان! کی گفته اینو بپرسی؟!

SCRIPT.ENGLISH: Why not? You said to ask right away.
SCRIPT.CHINESE_SIMPLIFIED: 怎么啦？不是您说让随时问的嘛
SCRIPT.CHINESE_TRADITIONAL: 為什麼？你不是讓我隨時問的嗎...
SCRIPT.JAPANESE: なんでですか？すぐに聞いてって言ったじゃないですか
SCRIPT.INDONESIAN: Kenapa nggak boleh? Tadi katanya boleh nanya langsung.
SCRIPT.PORTUGUESE: A senhora mesma disse pra eu perguntar.
SCRIPT.PERSIAN: چرا نه؟ گفتی همین الان بپرس

SCRIPT.KOREAN: 뭐, 너가 몇 명을 생각하는지는 모르겠지만 너 생각만큼 많진 않아.
SCRIPT.ENGLISH: I don’t know how many you’re imagining, but it’s not as many as you think.
SCRIPT.CHINESE_SIMPLIFIED: 虽然不知道你以为我交过多少，但其实没你想的那么多
SCRIPT.CHINESE_TRADITIONAL: 雖然不知道你以為我交過多少，但其實沒你想的那麽多
SCRIPT.JAPANESE: 何人予想してるか分からないけど、想像してるほど多くはないよ
SCRIPT.INDONESIAN: Aku nggak tahu kamu ngebayanginnya berapa, tapi nggak sebanyak yang kamu pikir.
SCRIPT.PORTUGUESE: Não sei quantos você imagina, mas não foram tantos quanto pensa.
SCRIPT.SPANISH: No sé cuántos imaginas, pero no fueron tantos como crees.
SCRIPT.PERSIAN: نمی‌دونم چند نفر را تصور می‌کنین، اما اون‌قدر که فکر می‌کنین نیست.

SCRIPT.ENGLISH: Still, it’s not zero like me.
SCRIPT.CHINESE_SIMPLIFIED: 那也比我这种交过0个的强吧
SCRIPT.CHINESE_TRADITIONAL: 不過總不會像我一樣是沒有吧
SCRIPT.JAPANESE: でも俺みたいに“ゼロ”ではないでしょ
SCRIPT.INDONESIAN: Tapi tetep aja, nggak nol kayak aku.
SCRIPT.PORTUGUESE: Mas também não é zero. Diferente de mim, por exemplo...
SCRIPT.SPANISH: Pero tampoco son 0. Como yo, por ejemplo...
SCRIPT.PERSIAN: با این حال، مثل من صفر نیست.

SCRIPT.ENGLISH: Do you think I’m the same as Yuman?
SCRIPT.JAPANESE: 私とユマンさんは違うでしょ
SCRIPT.INDONESIAN: Kamu pikir aku sama kayak kamu, Yuman?
SCRIPT.PERSIAN: به نظر شما من همون یومان هستم؟

SCRIPT.KOREAN: 저 약속 때문에 가봐야 할 거 같아요.
SCRIPT.ENGLISH: I think I need to head out for an appointment.
SCRIPT.CHINESE_SIMPLIFIED: 我还有约，可能得先走了
SCRIPT.CHINESE_TRADITIONAL: 我還有約，好像得先走了
SCRIPT.JAPANESE: 俺、ちょっと約束があって行かなきゃです
SCRIPT.INDONESIAN: Kayaknya aku harus pergi sekarang, ada janji.
SCRIPT.PORTUGUESE: Acho que preciso ir, tenho um compromisso.
SCRIPT.SPANISH: Creo que debo irme, tengo un compromiso.
SCRIPT.PERSIAN: فکر کنم باید برم واسه یه قرار
